frames.title: The Evidence-Based Desire Calendar: January Overview
frames.on_screen:
The Evolve Desire Calendar
How Desires Change Throughout The Year: The Evidence-Based Desire Calendar
Based on comprehensive analysis of US consumer behavior data from 2021-2025
1 JANUARY: Transformation Desires Peak
TOP 3 PRIORITY DESIRES & WHY:
1. CONTROL - January triggers the strongest "Fresh Start Effect" with 47% spike in gym visits and massive organization/decluttering behavior as people seek control after holiday chaos.
2. HEALTH - Winter's harshest months trigger ancestral conservation instincts, driving 35-40% increase in health spending (vitamins, supplements, preventive care).
3. STATUS - Career advancement and self-improvement peak as people seek to become "better versions" of themselves.
Core Desires:
• Physical Transformation: "New year, new me" mentality peaks -> HEALTH (health/staying alive)
• Organization & Control: Home organization, decluttering surge -> CONTROL (having power over environment)
• Financial Discipline: Budgeting, saving, "getting my finances together" -> CONTROL (having power over finances)
• Career Advancement: Job searching, skill development plans -> STATUS (being respected, better than others)
Opportunity: Target transformation desires when motivation is highest, but keep price points accessible as consumers recover from holiday spending.
frames.not_in_transcript: All text details for January: specific percentages (47% spike in gym visits, 35-40% increase in health spending), Core Desires breakdown (Physical Transformation, Organization & Control, Financial Discipline, Career Advancement), and Opportunity section.

frames.title: December: Connection & Celebration Desires
frames.on_screen:
12 DECEMBER: Connection & Celebration Desires
TOP 3 PRIORITY DESIRES & WHY:
1. BELONGING - Peak emotional spending ($240.8B) prioritizes relationships over price as winter's low serotonin intensifies connection needs.
2. COMFORT - Holiday traditions and celebrations ($261 average on seasonal products) provide warmth and joy during year's darkest months.
3. STATUS - Gift-giving ($641 average) demonstrates care and social awareness while maintaining relationship hierarchies and obligations.
Core Desires:
• Connection & Love: Expressing care through gift-giving -> BELONGING (not be rejected, maintain relationships)
• Tradition & Continuity: Maintaining family and cultural traditions -> BELONGING (participating in cultural celebrations)
• Joy & Celebration: Creating magical moments and memories -> COMFORT (avoid pain, enjoy pleasure)
• Social Belonging: Participating in cultural celebrations -> BELONGING (participating in celebrations)
Opportunity: Peak emotional spending when people prioritize relationships over price.
The Data:
• Cyber Monday reached record $13.3 billion in 2024, with total holiday season spending hitting $240.8 billion
• Average holiday spending per person reached record $902 in 2024, with $641 on gifts and $261 on seasonal products
frames.not_in_transcript: All specific metrics and points for December: $240.8B total holiday spending, $261 average on seasonal products, $641 average on gifts, Cyber Monday $13.3B in 2024, average holiday spending per person $902.

frames.title: February: Relationship & Self-Love Desires
frames.on_screen:
2 FEBRUARY: Relationship & Self-Love Desires
TOP 3 PRIORITY DESIRES & WHY:
1. SEX - Valentine's Day drives $27.5 billion in spending as hormonal surge creates 30% increase in dating app activity and appearance-focused purchases.
2. BELONGING - Record 32% spending on friends and 19% on co-workers shows expansion beyond romantic love to all social connections.
3. STATUS - Social recognition through thoughtful gift-giving peaks as people want to be seen as caring and generous.
Core Desires:
• Romantic Connection: Traditional Valentine's focus on significant others -> SEX (be attractive, find mate, feel desired)
• Platonic Love: Record spending on friends, family, co-workers -> BELONGING (fit in, have friends, not be rejected)
• Self-Love: "Galentine's Day" and treating yourself trends -> SEX (feel attractive/desired)
• Social Recognition: Being seen as thoughtful and caring -> STATUS (be respected, better than others)
Opportunity: Expand beyond romantic love to all forms of appreciation and self-care.
The Data:
• Valentine's Day spending reached record $27.5 billion in 2025, up from $25.8 billion in 2024
• 56% of consumers plan to celebrate Valentine's Day, with average spending of $188.81 per person
• 32% plan to purchase gifts for friends (highest in survey history), 19% for co-workers (also a record)
3 + 4 MARCH-APRIL: Action & Renewal Desires

frames.title: July-August: Lifestyle & Preparation Desires
frames.on_screen:
7 + 8 JULY-AUGUST: Lifestyle & Preparation Desires
TOP 3 PRIORITY DESIRES & WHY:
1. COMFORT - Peak summer lifestyle with 3.1 average trips per person and immediate gratification seeking as vitamin D and dopamine reach annual highs.
2. STATUS - Social status through summer activities peaks as body image concerns and "looking good" for vacations dominate spending.
3. CONTROL - Back-to-school preparation anxiety ($128B spending) drives early planning and organization behaviors.
Core Desires:
• Present-Moment Living: Summer experiences, immediate gratification -> COMFORT (avoid pain, enjoy pleasure)

frames.title: September: Achievement & Structure Desires
frames.on_screen:
9 SEPTEMBER: Achievement & Structure Desires
TOP 3 PRIORITY DESIRES & WHY:
1. CONTROL - Back-to-school creates "September is the new January" fresh start effect with structure and routine re-establishment.
2. STATUS - Learning, growth, and ensuring children's success drive $127.6B in combined spending as parents seek social approval.
3. BELONGING - "Back-to-school energy" affects all adults, creating community participation and social integration behaviors.
Core Desires:
• Structure & Routine: Re-establishing school year rhythms -> CONTROL (having power over environment)
• Learning & Growth: Education, skill-building, productivity focus -> STATUS (being better, more respected)
• Fresh Start: "September is the new January" mentality -> CONTROL (having power over what happens)
• Parental Success: Ensuring children are prepared and successful -> STATUS (being seen as good parent)
Opportunity: Lead with CONTROL ("Take charge of your fall routine") then layer STATUS ("Be the parent/professional everyone admires"). September's $127.6B spending proves people will pay premium for structure and success during this secondary fresh start period.
The Data:
• Back-to-school shoppers complete their $38.8 billion in spending, second-highest on record
• Americans take average of 3.1 summer trips, with 41% planning trips of 3 nights or fewer

frames.title: October and November Desires and Market Data
frames.on_screen:
TOP 3 PRIORITY DESIRES & WHY:
1. STATUS - Halloween costume choices ($3.8B) reveal aspirational identities and "Maskenfreiheit" - freedom to explore who you want to be.
2. BELONGING - Cultural tradition participation peaks with 77% buying decorations as "cuffing season" begins and social bonding intensifies.
3. CONTROL - Seasonal transformation through home decorating allows environmental control as daylight decreases trigger nesting behaviors.
Core Desires:
• Identity Expression: Costume choices reveal aspirational selves -> STATUS (showing who you are, being respected)
• Social Belonging: Participating in cultural traditions and parties -> BELONGING (participating in traditions)
• Seasonal Transformation: Home and yard decorating as seasonal identity -> CONTROL (power over environment)
• Controlled Fear: Safe scares and controlled excitement -> COMFORT (safe excitement, avoiding real danger)
Opportunity: Halloween has become "a whole season" - start messaging in September.
The Data:
• Halloween spending reached $12.2 billion in 2023, $11.6 billion in 2024
• 77% purchase decorations ($3.8B), 69% buy costumes ($3.8B), with 47% starting shopping before October
• Halloween decorations spending increased 42% from 2019-2024 ($2.6B to $3.8B)
11 NOVEMBER: Gratitude & Preparation Desires
TOP 3 PRIORITY DESIRES & WHY:
1. BELONGING - Thanksgiving drives family harmony and tradition participation as seasonal affective patterns increase bonding needs.
2. COMFORT - Black Friday deal-hunting ($10.8B online) provides dopamine surges from "winning" while avoiding financial pain.
3. CONTROL - Holiday preparation intensifies (45% begin shopping) as people seek to avoid December stress and chaos.
frames.not_in_transcript: "Maskenfreiheit" - freedom to explore who you want to be; cuffing season begins; November Top 3 Priority Desires: Thanksgiving family harmony, Black Friday deal-hunting ($10.8B online), Holiday preparation (45% begin shopping).
